pages.quiz:
MANDARIN — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #20
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: MANDARIN
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which two syllables blend to make 椅子? (1 mark)
   A. diàn and shì
   B. bīng and xiāng
   C. zhuō and zi
   D. yǐ and zi

2. On which vowel does the tone mark go in nǐ? (1 mark)
   A. No vowel
   B. i
   C. n
   D. u

3. What does 吃 (chī) mean? (1 mark)
   A. To like
   B. Beef
   C. To eat
   D. Lunch

4. Which Chinese word means "it rains"? (1 mark)
   A. 下雨 xià yǔ
   B. 刮风 guā fēng
   C. 太阳 tàiyáng
   D. 天 tiān

5. How long is the pause at a full stop compared with a comma? (1 mark)
   A. There is no pause
   B. Longer
   C. Shorter
   D. The same

6. What does 用 (yòng) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Shoulder
   B. To use
   C. Ear
   D. Two (before a counting word)

7. What does 风 (fēng) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Wind
   B. Not
   C. Flood
   D. Cloud

8. What is special about Mandarin words for brothers and sisters? (1 mark)
   A. They are all the same word
   B. They are only used by adults
   C. There are different words for older and younger ones
   D. They have no tones

9. Which character has an extra line on top of 大? (1 mark)
   A. 入
   B. 人
   C. 太
   D. 天

10. Which sentence means "We cut the cake."? (1 mark)
   A. 我们切蛋糕。
   B. 你生日是几月几号?
   C. 我们唱歌。
   D. 祝你生日快乐!

11. What does 今天星期几? jīntiān xīngqī jǐ? ask? (1 mark)
   A. What is your name?
   B. Where is school?
   C. How many people are there?
   D. What day of the week is it today?

12. Read the pinyin: zhù nǐ shēngrì kuàilè! What does it mean? (1 mark)
   A. When is your birthday?
   B. My birthday is on 5 March.
   C. Happy birthday to you!
   D. My friend gives me a gift.

13. What does 祝 (zhù) mean? (1 mark)
   A. To wish
   B. Cup
   C. Knife
   D. They

14. Which day is 星期四? (1 mark)
   A. Thursday
   B. Tuesday
   C. Friday
   D. Wednesday

15. What does 唱歌 (chànggē) mean? (1 mark)
   A. We
   B. Date (day of the month)
   C. Candle
   D. To sing

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "For breakfast I eat bǐng." (2 marks)

17. Write a dialogue of five lines in Chinese with pinyin between two learners about a food picture: ask what it is, answer, ask if they like it, and reply. (5 marks)

18. What does it mean to listen for gist? Give one way to do it. (2 marks)

19. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 谢谢, 哭 and 星期三. (3 marks)

20. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "Happy birthday to you!" (3 marks)
pages.answers:
MANDARIN — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #20 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — yǐ and zi
   yǐ + zi = yǐzi, chair.

2. B — i
   The only vowel is i, and the mark replaces its dot.

3. C — To eat
   吃 (chī) means to eat.

4. A — 下雨 xià yǔ
   下雨 (xià yǔ) means it rains.

5. B — Longer
   A full stop needs a longer pause.

6. B — To use
   用 (yòng) means to use.

7. A — Wind
   风 (fēng) means wind.

8. C — There are different words for older and younger ones
   Mandarin has gēge and dìdi, jiějie and mèimei.

9. D — 天
   天 tiān is 大 with a line on top.

10. A — 我们切蛋糕。
   我们切蛋糕。 (wǒmen qiē dàngāo.) means "We cut the cake.".

11. D — What day of the week is it today?
   几 asks which number, so 星期几 asks which day of the week.

12. C — Happy birthday to you!
   zhù nǐ shēngrì kuàilè! is 祝你生日快乐!, which means "Happy birthday to you!".

13. A — To wish
   祝 (zhù) means to wish.

14. A — Thursday
   四 is four, so 星期四 is week four, Thursday.

15. D — To sing
   唱歌 (chànggē) means to sing.

SECTION B
----
16. (2 marks)
   Answer: 我早饭吃饼。 wǒ zǎofàn chī bǐng.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

17. (5 marks)
   Answer: A: 这是什么? zhè shì shénme? B: 这是香蕉。 zhè shì xiāngjiāo. A: 你喜欢吃香蕉吗? nǐ xǐhuan chī xiāngjiāo ma? B: 我喜欢。 wǒ xǐhuan. A: 谢谢! xièxie!
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each line with pinyin.

18. (2 marks)
   Answer: Listening for gist means finding the main idea. You can listen for key words you already know.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for meaning and 1 mark for a method.

19. (3 marks)
   Answer: 谢谢: xièxie, thank you. 哭: kū, to cry. 星期三: xīngqīsān, Wednesday.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

20. (3 marks)
   Answer: 祝你生日快乐! zhù nǐ shēngrì kuàilè!
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters in the correct order, 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks, 1 mark for punctuation.
